$comment: Phase 0 data-quality thresholds. Research defaults, not optimised. All ages in seconds.

candleLag.$comment: Market-hours aware for every engine-supported timeframe (M1..H1 UTC buckets, H4/D1 New York 17:00 buckets). missingBars = expected buckets containing open market time after the latest closed candle whose close_time + grace <= now. Unsupported timeframes (W1/MN1) are always STALE (fail-safe).

badTick.$comment: maxJumpPct: quote mid vs reference price. candleRangeMedianMultiple: candle range vs median range of lookback closed candles.
